description_en: Adds a workspace member and assigns a workspace-level role to the member
description_zh: 添加工作空间成员同时授予工作空间角色
name: CreateProjectMember

parameters.description_en:
The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID.

You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied.
parameters.description_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间。

parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the account that you want to add to the workspace as a member. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/product/ms_menu), choose More > Management Center in the left-side navigation pane, select the desired workspace on the Management Center page, and then click Go to Management Center. In the left-side navigation pane of the SettingCenter page, click **Tenant Members and Roles**. On the Tenant Members and Roles page, view the ID of the account that you want to add to the workspace as a member.
parameters.description_zh: Dataworks账号 ID 。您可以登录[ DataWorks 控制台—管理中心](https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/product/ms_menu)，选择需要添加成员的工作空间进入管理中心页面，进入 **租户成员与角色** 页面，查看需要加入工作空间的账号 ID。

parameters.description_en:
The codes of the roles in the workspace. You can call the [ListProjectRoles](~~2853930~~) operation to query the codes of all roles in the workspace.

This parameter specifies the roles that you can assign to a member when you add the member.
parameters.description_zh:
工作空间角色 Code 列表。 您可以调用[ListProjectRoles](~~2853930~~) 获取角色的 Code。

该参数用来添加空间成员时同步授予其工作空间角色 。
